title: Tam Coc golden rice in 3 days
summary: Hanoi, Tam Coc, and Ninh Binh in late May to early June.

days.title: Day 1 — Hanoi
days.body: Land and walk Hoan Kiem Lake.

days.title: Day 2 — Tam Coc
days.body: The three caves are about 2 hours on the water. An adult is 250,000 VND.

days.title: Day 3 — Trang An or Hang Mua
days.body: Trang An is 300,000 đồng for an adult over 1.3 m. Hang Mua is 150,000 VND per person.
